notes:
Context: mid-sized contact center SaaS that powers 3rd-party help desks. Longtime latency-sensitive customers (financial services + telco). Primary ask: real-time agent assist with streaming suggestions integrated into agent UI, plus safe tool-calling for CRM updates. Key quotes from calls: "can’t tolerate suggestion lag >200ms at agent level" and "we need deterministic fallbacks during spikes". \nKey requirements summary:
- Streaming suggestions: token-by-token streaming into agent UI, ability to interrupt/rollback suggestions.
- Latency SLOs: target p50 < 40ms, p95 < 150ms for suggestion turn; end-to-end (incl. network) target p95 < 250ms.
- Throughput: peak concurrency 3k concurrent agents across regions during campaigns; sustained 600-800 concurrent.
- Spike behavior: 4x baseline during overnight campaigns; must not drop connections. Prefer Dedicated pool with burst autoscale and cross-region fallback.
- Guardrails: model-level safety filters, rule-based post-processing, provenance headers for suggestions, redact PII before suggestions.
- Tool-calling: authenticated signed tokens for CRM writes, audit logging per action, idempotency keys.
- Model prefs: prefer open/quantized variants for cost; fallback to smaller model at p95 miss. Need evaluation on hallucination rates for tool-calling.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to commit to reserved Dedicated if latency and reliability proven.
Notes style: shorthand, action items, quick clips from calls (see fireflies ids).
